title: Kickstarter Email Finder
description: Finds live and upcoming Kickstarter campaigns, reads each creator's website and bio, searches the sites for emails and grades every email. Saves progress and rotates through several ScraperAPI and Reoon keys.

categoryIds.title: Kickstarter category ids
categoryIds.description: Technology is 16, Film and Video is 11, Games is 12, Design is 7.

scraperApiKeys.title: ScraperAPI keys
scraperApiKeys.description: A JSON list of keys. When one runs out the next is used.

reoonKeys.title: Reoon keys (optional)
reoonKeys.description: A JSON list of Reoon keys, used to check that a mailbox really exists.

maxPagesPerList.title: Maximum pages per list this run
maxPagesPerList.description: Use 0 for unlimited. Each page holds about 12 campaigns.
